panels.title: Temperaturas
panels.description: Franja roja: helada (< 0 °C). Franja naranja: riesgo (0 a 3 °C).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "iot_ganado")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ganado")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temp_amb" or r._field == "temp_suelo1" or r._field == "temp_suelo2" or r._field == "temp_bmp")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: if r._field == "temp_amb" then "Ambiente" else if r._field == "temp_suelo1" then "Suelo 1" else if r._field == "temp_suelo2" then "Suelo 2" else if r._field == "temp_bmp" then "BMP280" else r._field}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])

from(bucket: "iot_ganado")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ganado")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "humedad")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: if r._field == "humedad" then "Humedad" else r._field}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])

panels.title: Temperatura vs punto de rocío
panels.description: Cuando las dos líneas se juntan, se forma rocío o escarcha.

targets.query:
import "math"
from(bucket: "iot_ganado")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ganado")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temp_amb" or r._field == "humedad")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.temp_amb and exists r.humedad and r.humedad > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, "Punto de rocío": 243.12 * (math.log(x: r.humedad / 100.0) + 17.62 * r.temp_amb / (243.12 + r.temp_amb)) / (17.62 - (math.log(x: r.humedad / 100.0) + 17.62 * r.temp_amb / (243.12 + r.temp_amb))), "Ambiente": r.temp_amb}))

from(bucket: "iot_ganado")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ganado")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "presion" or r._field == "presion_bmp")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: if r._field == "presion" then "Presión BME280" else if r._field == "presion_bmp" then "Presión BMP280" else r._field}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])

base = from(bucket: "iot_ganado")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ganado")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temp_amb")
mn = base
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: min, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Mínima"}))
mx = base
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Máxima"}))
union(tables: [mn, mx])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

from(bucket: "iot_ganado")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ganado")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temp_amb")
  |> min()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.title: Horas bajo 0 °C
panels.description: Aproximado: cada dato equivale a 10 s.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "iot_ganado")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ganado")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temp_amb")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value < 0.0)
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: float(v: r._value) * 10.0 / 3600.0}))

panels.title: Horas en riesgo (< 3 °C)
panels.description: Aproximado: cada dato equivale a 10 s.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "iot_ganado")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ganado")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temp_amb")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value < 3.0)
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: float(v: r._value) * 10.0 / 3600.0}))

from(bucket: "iot_ganado")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ganado")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "calefaccion" or r._field == "cortina" or r._field == "cortina_estado")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: if r._field == "calefaccion" then "Calefacción (orden)" else if r._field == "cortina" then "Cortina (orden)" else if r._field == "cortina_estado" then "Cortina (posición real)" else r._field}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])

from(bucket: "iot_ganado")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ganado")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "calefaccion" or r._field == "cortina_estado")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])
  |> duplicate(column: "_value", as: "estado")
  |> difference(columns: ["_value"], keepFirst: false)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value != 0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      Hora: r._time,
      Actuador: if r._field == "calefaccion" then "Calefacción" else "Cortina",
      Estado: if r._field == "calefaccion" then (if r.estado == 1 then "Encendida" else "Apagada")
        else if r.estado == 0 then "Recogida" else if r.estado == 1 then "Desplegada" else if r.estado == 2 then "Desplegando"
        else if r.estado == 3 then "Recogiendo" else if r.estado == 5 then "FALLA" else "Desconocida"
    }))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["Hora"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 50)

panels.title: Horas de calefacción por día (últimos 7 días)
panels.description: Calculado con el promedio del estado de la calefacción en cada día.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "iot_ganado")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ganado")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "calefaccion")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value)}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value * 24.0, _field: "Horas encendida"}))

from(bucket: "iot_ganado")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ganado")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "rssi" or r._field == "snr")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: if r._field == "rssi" then "RSSI" else if r._field == "snr" then "SNR" else r._field}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])

from(bucket: "iot_ganado")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ganado")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "perdidos")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: if r._field == "perdidos" then "Paquetes perdidos" else r._field}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])

from(bucket: "iot_ganado")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ganado")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "seq")
  |> count()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

from(bucket: "iot_ganado")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ganado")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "seq" or r._field == "perdidos")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ok: if r._field == "seq" then 1.0 else 0.0, pd: if r._field == "perdidos" then float(v: r._value) else 0.0}))
  |> reduce(identity: {ok: 0.0, pd: 0.0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({ok: accumulator.ok + r.ok, pd: accumulator.pd + r.pd}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: if r.ok + r.pd > 0.0 then 100.0 * r.pd / (r.ok + r.pd) else 0.0}))

from(bucket: "iot_ganado")
